feeds.title: Hip Mama's Place
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Jocelyn Brown, Founder and Editor of Hip Mama's Place. In early 2007, I stumbled upon a mom blog that inspired me so much to create my own blog, Hip Mama's Place. My goal has always been to make Hip Mama's Place not only a helpful site that brings moms the latest trends in mom, baby/kids, and family-friendly products and services, but also offer helpful money-saving ideas, family-friendly events, fun giveaways for the whole family, giving back to the community and more!

feeds.title: The DC Moms
feeds.description: The DC Moms was originally founded in 2010 as a collaborative local blog by and for area parents. Editor Sandie Angulo Chen has been running it since 2012, with an evolving team of contributing writers. She's been writing about pop-culture and parenting for 20 years.

feeds.title: KidFriendly DC
feeds.description: KidFriendly DC is the go-to resource for the scoop on the best recreation, events, entertainment, and activities with kids in the Washington, DC-Metro area. From the tried and true to the new and cool, find out where to go and what to do with the kiddos in the nation's capital.

feeds.title: Mom the Magnificent
feeds.description: I'm Robyn and I started this blog back in 2015 to share tales, tips, and tricks of the trade with all of you! Spend any amount of time on my blog and you'll see that I'm also a huge Disney nerd, and I'll take any opportunity I have to travel. I hope your visit to my blog makes you smile, encourages you, or perhaps inspires an idea or two along the way.

feeds.title: DC Real Estate Mama
feeds.description: Living in DC is not just about politics. I'm a Realtor and work all over the DC, MD, and Northern VA area every day. My blog posts are all about life in DC, the pros& cons, and what it's like to live here, buy a home here, send your kids to schools here and have fun here. Get to know the neighborhoods, the businesses, and some history too!

feeds.title: Tech Savvy Mama
feeds.description: I'm the founder of the award-winning tech-savvy mama, a site that since 2008, has been helping parents navigate parenting in the digital age. I've combined my knowledge of child development, psychology, education, tech and parenting to provide useful advice for families about digital parenting topics since 2008.

feeds.title: Mom of Mamony » Washington DC
feeds.description: Mom of Mamony is a family travel blog chronicling the adventures of a solo mom and her daughter as they explore Washington, DC, and beyond. The Washington, DC section of the blog offers a wealth of resources for families seeking engaging and educational activities in the nation's capital.

feeds.title: District Mix
feeds.description: District Mix is a lifestyle blog curated by Linda, a longtime Washington, DC resident and mother of two teens. With over 28 years in the city, Linda offers a blend of personal insights and recommendations that reflect her deep connection to DC. The blog covers a diverse array of topics, including local events, travel experiences, home and style tips, cultural happenings, and family-friendly activities.

feeds.title: Penniless Parenting
feeds.description: Hello there! I'm Penny Price, the voice behind this blog. I'm a globe-trotting, adventure-seeking, fantasy-loving divorced mom of four with a passion for budget-friendly travel, diverse cuisines, and creative problem-solving. I share practical tips on frugal living, allergy-friendly cooking, and making the most of life—even with chronic illness.

feeds.title: DudeMom
feeds.description: Dude Mom is a humor, lifestyle blog written by the best mom in the world. She loves helping moms up their style awesome by sharing easy, affordable, and stylish wardrobe tips. She also helps businesses design and manage effective social media campaigns and work as a community manager, social media strategist, copywriter, and content developer for brands and businesses.

feeds.title: I'm Not the Nanny
feeds.description: As the mom of biracial children, I've been mistaken for the nanny, depending on which DC Metro park I visit. I started this site as a way to share the challenges and joys of raising biracial children. It has evolved as I share my foodie obsessions, my journey towards a healthier lifestyle, and the latest tech and app I'm addicted to.

feeds.title: The Mummy Chronicles
feeds.description: The Mummy Chronicles (TMC) is a lifestyle blog created in 2006 by Victoria Mason. At first a regular 'mommy blog' it has expanded to explore daily fashion trends, tips and ways to shop your closet. In addition, Victoria offers car reviews, industry news and her continuing journey in trying to stay fit as a parent in a very busy world.

feeds.title: Crunchy-Chewy Mama
feeds.description: I'm Jessica Claire Haney, on Earth Day 2014, I launched the website I wished had existed when I became a parent. Mindful Healthy Life of Metro DC is an online lifestyle magazine for Metro DC-area families interested in holistic health, natural living and mindful parenting. Around here, I do my best to live as healthfully as possible. But compromises abound.

feeds.title: Angelica In The City Blog
feeds.description: I began Angelica In The City in April 2016, it is a source of inspiration that covers everything from travel and fitness to parenting, attainable luxury and style, home decor and more. I hope to encourage people to discover new places to get fit, delicious places to eat, exciting things to see and fun things to do in the Washington DC area and beyond.

feeds.title: Baby Castan On Board
feeds.description: I'm Melissa, and I work full-time as a meeting planner. After I had my first child, I wanted to document everything, so we would remember what worked the first time around, and hopefully help other first-time mamas along the way! You will find tips on traveling with kids, photography, activities to keep toddlers busy and engaged, and anything else related to mom life.much more.

feeds.title: The Mummy Chronicles
feeds.description: The Mummy Chronicles (TMC) is a lifestyle blog created in 2006 by Victoria Mason. At first a regular 'mommy blog' it has expanded to explore daily fashion trends, tips and ways to shop your closet. In addition, Victoria offers car reviews, industry news and her continuing journey in trying to stay fit as a parent in a very busy world.

feeds.title: DC Widow
feeds.description: I started this blog. Within 24 hours of starting it, I had a dozen ideas for blog topics. DC Widow is a personal blog with a focus on life, kids, community, and everyday events. I share my frustrations, worry, and sadness that have been bottled up inside of me since the day I lost my husband.

feeds.title: DC Thrifty Mom
feeds.description: My name is Nicole and I'm a married mother of two daughters. I started blogging in January 2013 to offer a time-saving resource, which introduces area families to enriching affordable activities by highlighting free, cheap and discounted local events. As the founder and publisher of DC Thrifty Mom, my efforts and passion are to encourage families to seize the opportunities of cost-saving activities, products, tips, and reviews without breaking the household budget.
